name: nvm
description: Installs nvm (Node Version Manager) into the remote user's home and optionally a Node version (defaults to LTS). No yarn.

version.description: nvm release tag to install (without the leading `v`).

node.description: Node version to install via nvm. `lts` uses `nvm install --lts`. `none` skips node install. Anything else is passed as-is to `nvm install`.
